comment: One row for each check that the calls_heap increment adds: the producer, the obligation
flag of the summary, the heap witness after a call, and the report. A row
names the line that holds the check and the text that breaks it.
The build compiles working-tree HEAD with the mutant. The module tests compile src/fort
with the mutant too. The stages run from the narrowest tests to the driver test.
The table runs in the Linux VM with the debug preset.
Run it with a --runner that calls tools/vm run and then waits 2 s after each ninja
build; without that pause a first row can read stale (notes/testing.md).

stages.name: calls module tests
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 900 -j 6 ownership_source_calls ownership_heap ownership_report
